errors.text: The target material is not identified specifically as as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA with FCC and B2 phases; the hypothesis instead spans materially distinct refractory and eutectic HEAs.

The predicted transition is primarily parameterized by aging time at a fixed temperature, whereas the target transition is a temperature-dependent ductility minimum near 600°C followed by recovery near 750°C.

The proposed mechanism omits the key coupling between enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains, jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries, planar slip or cross-slip restriction, and crack initiation at phase-boundary tips.
